lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Alright, I'm Kevin Doyle. I'm an electrician, and I'm the only one here who brought actual snacks.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: I'm Hannah Kim. I'm a lawyer, and I'm getting married next spring.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Sam Torres. I work at REI, and I'm the designated driver tonight, sadly.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: I'm Chris Porter. I'm an accountant, and my wife Megan Walsh is making me text her every hour.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: So who's playing at Red Rocks tonight again?

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Kevin. You bought the tickets. It's the Lumineers.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Right, right. I just buy whatever the group chat tells me to.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: Where's Megan tonight, Chris?

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Book club. They're reading something with a dead husband in it, and she keeps looking at me funny.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: Ha! You two have been together forever. Bonnaroo 2014, right?

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Yep, Bonnaroo 2014. Eleven years ago this month. I still have the tent, actually. Megan wants me to throw it out, but I think it's a historical artifact. It's the whole reason we're married. Honestly, I want to be buried in that tent.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: That's disgusting and also romantic.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Speaking of history, Kevin, you are officially the slowest Sunday Sends member ever to finish the blue wall.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: I've only been in the crew since 2019. Give me some time.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: You joined in 2020, Kevin. You came to your first session right after the gyms reopened.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: No, it was the fall of 2019, before everything shut down.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: I'm pretty sure it was 2020.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: I'm not getting in the middle of this.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Kevin, how's Jenna doing?

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: She's great. She just got promoted to head nurse at Saint Joseph's. We've been married almost seven years now. We met at a wedding in 2015. Wait, no, 2016. It was my cousin's wedding in Pittsburgh. Her name was Jenna Lowe back then, and she was the only person at that whole wedding who would dance with me to Mister Brightside.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: And Kevin's bachelor party is still a legend.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Austin, 2018. Five guys, one rented pontoon boat, and Kevin decided he could drive it without reading a single instruction. We got stuck on a sandbar for three hours, and a family of total strangers on jet skis had to tow us back to the dock. Kevin tipped them forty dollars and a cooler of beer.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Best forty dollars I ever spent.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Who else was on that boat? Matt?

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Matt Fisher, yeah. He's my coworker. We wire houses together. And he's the commissioner of the Dynasty League now.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Which he runs like a dictator.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Arjun and I founded that league, and we have absolutely no power anymore.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: Okay, Kevin, were you there when Owen tore his knee in Breckenridge?

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Oh, I was there. Breckenridge, the winter of 2022. I carried his skis all the way down.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Poor Owen. He still won't go near a green run.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: He's doing great now, though. He's helping me plan the wedding, which is a sentence I never thought I'd say about my ex.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Oh, by the way, my coworker Kate Russo is meeting us there. She's the one who runs the climbing clinics at REI.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Kate Russo? Not Kate Miller?

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Definitely not Kate Miller. Why would Kate Miller be coming?

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Because Kate Miller is my ex girlfriend from college, and she texted me last week saying she'd be at Red Rocks tonight. We dated from 2012 to 2014, it ended badly, and I have not seen her since.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: Oh, this is going to be a great night.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Does Megan know Kate is going to be there?

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: I'm going to text her right now.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: Okay, while he does that, Sam, tell me about the new climbing route.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: So, there's a crack climb up in Eldorado Canyon called the Bastille Crack. Owen and I tried it last fall and bailed halfway up. This summer the whole crew is going back, me, Owen, Hannah, and Kevin, and we are not leaving until everyone tops out. Even if it takes until dark. Even if Kevin cries.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: I'll be there, assuming wedding planning doesn't kill me first.

lines.speaker: Chris Porter
lines.text: Okay. Megan says, and I quote, have fun and don't be weird.

lines.speaker: Kevin Doyle
lines.text: Ha, true. Solid advice.

lines.speaker: Sam Torres
lines.text: Alright, everybody in the car. Last call for snacks.

lines.speaker: Hannah Kim
lines.text: Grab the chips, Kevin.
